decision.observation: At 8:00 p.m. Saturday, the farmer is on the clear path south of the fountain; the east–west cobblestone junction is visible farther below.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing south briefly will reach the junction without entering the wooded southern exit; the beach route then turns east across the river.
decision.memory: Willy invited the farmer to the southeast beach. At the southern town junction, go east across the river before turning south; do not continue into the wooded area directly south of town.
